class.name: VertexOptimizationReport
class.description: Contains measured runtime metrics and a list of recommendations, each with a severity, message, optional action, and target. Use [method to_dictionary] to serialize it.

method.name: get_critical_count
method.description: Returns the number of critical recommendations.

method.name: get_recommendation
method.description: Returns the recommendation at the given index, or an empty dictionary if out of range.

method.name: get_recommendations
method.description: Returns all recommendations as an array of dictionaries.

method.name: get_warning_count
method.description: Returns the number of warning recommendations.

method.name: to_dictionary
method.description: Serializes the report to a dictionary.
